en: The Dyad on the Taints (Āsavaduka), The Triad with the Visible (Sanidassanattika)
Dependent on a state that is neither an outflow, nor visible, nor impinging, there arises a state that is not an outflow, but is visible and impinging, by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither an outflow, nor visible, nor impinging, there arises a state that is not an outflow, but is visible and impinging, by way of root condition … one.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three … pe …
In the case of resultant [condition], one; ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a state that is not-outflow, not-visible, and impinging ... (Three questions according to the previous method. In the case of root, three; in the case of predominance, three; ... pe ... in the case of mutuality, one; ... pe ... in the case of resultant, one; ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a state that is not-outflow, not-visible, and non-impinging, arises a state that is not-outflow, not-visible, and non-impinging by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root, one; in the case of predominance, one; ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, one.
